verdict.rationale: Terraform's native `terraform test` framework explicitly runs against test-specific, short-lived resources with provider-mocking support, preventing risk to existing infrastructure/state (terraform-docs-7/21/27/28), and hands-on probes confirm a full plan→apply→drift-check→destroy loop can run headlessly with no account/production contact (terraform-probe-6/7/8). Combined with plan/preview machine-readable output for CI gating, this gives an AI agent a safe way to validate changes without touching prod. missing for 10: dedicated cloud 'sandbox environment/workspace' concept distinct from local ephemeral resources, independent third-party validation of test-mocking reliability in production-scale use, explicit documentation of isolating from real cloud accounts beyond local CLI probes
